Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student user in the SyllabiQ platform. Authentication and core user profile data are assumed to be managed by an external system. This entity focuses on minimal student information required for partner matching and display.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

name.description: The student's display name, typically first name and last initial.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the student's profile image.

StudyPartnerProfile.title: StudyPartnerProfile
StudyPartnerProfile.description: Stores specific preferences and settings for a student related to the Study Partner feature, used for matching and discovery.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPartnerProfile entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who owns this study partner profile. (Relationship: Student 1:1 StudyPartnerProfile)

targetExam.description: The target examination the student is preparing for (e.g., NEET, JEE Main, JEE Advanced).

subjects.description: A list of subjects the student is studying for the target exam.

studyHoursPerDay.description: The student's preferred daily study hour commitment (e.g., '2-3 hours').

preferredStudyTime.description: The preferred time range for studying (e.g., '6 AM - 8 AM').

bio.description: An optional short biography or statement of study goals.

status.description: The student's current availability status for matching (e.g., 'available', 'on_break', 'looking_for_partner').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the study partner profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the study partner profile was last updated.

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp when the student was last active in the study partner feature.

StudyPartnerConnection.title: StudyPartnerConnection
StudyPartnerConnection.description: Manages the relationship and shared data between two connected study partners, including status, match details, and moderation info.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPartnerConnection entity.

studentIdA.description: Reference to the ID of the first student in the connection. (Relationship: Student N:N StudyPartnerConnection)

studentIdB.description: Reference to the ID of the second student in the connection. (Relationship: Student N:N StudyPartnerConnection)

status.description: The current status of the connection (e.g., 'pending', 'active', 'blocked', 'ended').

matchScore.description: The compatibility score between the two students at the time of matching.

initiatedBy.description: Reference to the ID of the student who initiated this connection request. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudyPartnerConnection)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the connection request was initiated.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when the connection request was accepted, if applicable.

endedAt.description: Timestamp when the connection was ended, if applicable.

commonSubjects.description: A list of subjects common to both partners.

commonStudyTimeStart.description: The start hour (24-hour format) of the common study time overlap between partners.

commonStudyTimeEnd.description: The end hour (24-hour format) of the common study time overlap between partners.

mutualReportCount.description: A count of mutual reports against this connection, indicating potential issues.

isBlocked.description: Indicates if either student has blocked the other within this connection.

blockedBy.description: Reference to the ID of the student who initiated the block, if applicable. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudyPartnerConnection)

blockedReason.description: The reason provided for blocking the partner, if applicable.

messagesCount.description: Total number of messages exchanged within this connection.

lastMessageAt.description: Timestamp of the last message sent in this connection.

StudyPartnerMessage.title: StudyPartnerMessage
StudyPartnerMessage.description: Represents a message exchanged between two study partners within a specific connection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPartnerMessage entity.

connectionId.description: Reference to the StudyPartnerConnection this message belongs to. (Relationship: StudyPartnerConnection 1:N StudyPartnerMessage)

senderId.description: Reference to the ID of the student who sent the message. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudyPartnerMessage)

receiverId.description: Reference to the ID of the student who received the message. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudyPartnerMessage)

sentAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

readAt.description: Timestamp when the message was read by the receiver, if applicable.

sessionId.description: Reference to the StudySession during which this message was sent, if applicable. (Relationship: StudySession 1:N StudyPartnerMessage)

flaggedForReview.description: Indicates if the message has been flagged for moderation review.

flagReason.description: The reason the message was flagged for review, if applicable.

StudySession.title: StudySession
StudySession.description: Details about a single study session, whether initiated by an individual student or collaboratively within a study partner connection.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudySession entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the student who owns this personal study session log entry or initiated it individually. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudySession)

connectionId.description: Reference to the StudyPartnerConnection this session is associated with, if applicable. (Relationship: StudyPartnerConnection 1:N StudySession)

partnerId.description: Reference to the ID of the study partner involved in this session, if applicable. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudySession)

initiatedBy.description: Reference to the student who initiated this specific session instance. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudySession)

subject.description: The subject studied during the session.

plannedDuration.description: The planned duration of the session in seconds.

actualDuration.description: The actual duration the session lasted in seconds.

startedAt.description: Timestamp when the study session began.

endedAt.description: Timestamp when the study session ended, if applicable.

status.description: The current status of the study session (e.g., 'active', 'paused', 'completed', 'abandoned').

partnerJoinedAt.description: Timestamp when a partner joined this session, if applicable.

bothPartnersParticipated.description: Indicates if both partners actively participated in this session (true if it was a collaborative session and both were active).

completionBonus.description: Bonus points awarded to the student(s) for completing this session.

StudyPartnerMatch.title: StudyPartnerMatch
StudyPartnerMatch.description: Logs the history of potential study partner matches presented to students, including the outcome of the interaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the StudyPartnerMatch entity.

studentIdA.description: Reference to the ID of the first student involved in the match. (Relationship: Student N:N StudyPartnerMatch)

studentIdB.description: Reference to the ID of the second student involved in the match. (Relationship: Student N:N StudyPartnerMatch)

matchScore.description: The compatibility score between the two students for this specific match.

matchedAt.description: Timestamp when the match was generated or presented.

actionTaken.description: The action taken by the student on this match (e.g., 'connected', 'skipped', 'expired', 'declined').

actionTakenAt.description: Timestamp when the action was taken, if applicable.

actionTakenBy.description: Reference to the student who performed the action on the match, if applicable. (Relationship: Student 1:N StudyPartnerMatch)

definition.description: Core user profile data for a student. This collection holds general student information like 'name' and 'profileImageUrl'. Access is strictly limited to the owner. The 'studentId' parameter corresponds to the authenticated user's UID. Does not include study partner specific preferences.

Private study partner preferences and status for a specific student. This document is strictly readable and writable only by the owning student. Public-facing fields (e.g., targetExam, subjects, bio) necessary for partner display are denormalized into StudyPartnerConnection documents to ensure Authorization Independence when displaying connected partners.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student who owns this study partner profile, corresponding to request.auth.uid.

definition.description: Represents an active, pending, or ended study partnership between two students. This document includes denormalized 'studentIdA', 'studentIdB', and a 'participants' map for authorization independence, allowing direct participant checks in security rules. It also denormalizes public profile details for both partners (e.g., name, targetExam, subjects, bio) and critical real-time session status (e.g., 'currentActiveSession' details, 'isMessagingAllowedDuringOverlap') to facilitate secure messaging and session rules without 'get()' calls.

params.name: connectionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a study partner connection.

definition.description: Messages exchanged within a specific study partnership. Each message document includes denormalized 'senderId', 'receiverId', and a 'participants' map (from the parent connection) for authorization independence. Message creation, content moderation, and session-gating logic are strongly recommended to be handled by a Cloud Function for robust security, preventing the need for complex, 'get()'-violating rules.

params.name: connectionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent study partner connection.

params.name: messageId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific message within the connection.

definition.description: Details about a specific collaborative study session within a partnership. Each session document includes denormalized 'studentIdA', 'studentIdB', and a 'participants' map (from the parent connection) for authorization independence, allowing direct participant checks in security rules. This ensures only connected partners can interact with the session data.

params.name: connectionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent study partner connection.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific collaborative study session.

definition.description: Historical log of a potential match presented to a student. Each match document includes denormalized 'studentIdA', 'studentIdB', and a 'participants' map for authorization independence, allowing direct participant checks in security rules. This is used to track match outcomes and prevent re-showing rejected users for a period.

params.name: matchId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific match history entry.

definition.description: A personal log of all study sessions undertaken by a student, whether individual or part of a partnership. This document is strictly owned by the 'studentId'. It includes denormalized 'studentId' (owner) and 'partnerId' (if applicable) for authorization independence, enabling direct owner checks in security rules.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the student who owns this personal study session log entry.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific personal study session.

firestore.reasoning:
The proposed Firestore structure prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by strictly adhering to the core design principles, especially Authorization Independence and Structural Segregation. 

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL) & Denormalization:**
To eliminate the need for `get()` calls in security rules (which break atomic operations and complicate debugging), authorization contexts are denormalized across related documents:

1.  **`StudyPartnerProfile`:** This collection is nested under `students/{studentId}` and is strictly readable/writable only by the profile owner (`request.auth.uid == studentId`). Public-facing profile information (e.g., name, target exam, subjects, bio) required for displaying partners or during the matching process is **denormalized** into `StudyPartnerConnection` documents upon connection acceptance and into `StudyPartnerMatch` documents. This avoids requiring a `get()` call to individual `studyPartnerProfile` documents for displaying partner details.

2.  **`StudyPartnerConnection`:** Each document in `/studyPartnerConnections/{connectionId}` explicitly contains `studentIdA`, `studentIdB`, and a `participants` map (`{ [studentIdA]: true, [studentIdB]: true }`). This enables rules to directly check `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participants` without a `get()` call. Furthermore, critical real-time state for messaging (e.g., `currentActiveSession` details like `endTime` and `isMessagingAllowedDuringOverlap`) is also denormalized into the `StudyPartnerConnection` document. This makes the connection document self-sufficient for evaluating messaging permissions based on session status and study time overlap, preventing `get()` calls to `studySessions` from `messages` rules.

3.  **`StudyPartnerMessage` and `StudySession` (within connection):** Documents in `/studyPartnerConnections/{connectionId}/messages/{messageId}` and `/studyPartnerConnections/{connectionId}/studySessions/{sessionId}` also include the `participants` map (denormalized from their parent `StudyPartnerConnection` document). This ensures that any participant can be authorized to read/write these subcollection documents by checking `request.auth.uid in resource.data.participants` directly on the document itself. For message creation, content moderation, and session-gating, robust server-side validation via a **Cloud Function** is strongly recommended to ensure strict security without complex, potentially flawed, client-side rule evaluations that might implicitly violate the 'no get()' principle.

4.  **`StudyPartnerMatch`:** Similar to connections, documents in `/studyPartnerMatches/{matchId}` contain `studentIdA`, `studentIdB`, and a `participants` map, allowing for direct participant validation without `get()` calls.

**Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):**

1.  **Private vs. Collaborative Data:** Core student profiles (`/students/{studentId}`) and private study partner preferences (`/students/{studentId}/studyPartnerProfile`) are kept distinct from collaborative data (`/studyPartnerConnections/{connectionId}`) and its subcollections (`/messages`, `/studySessions`). This simplifies security rules, as each collection or subcollection inherently defines its access requirements.

2.  **Personal Session Logs:** `students/{studentId}/studySessions/{sessionId}` is a dedicated subcollection for a student's personal study history, maintaining strict path-based ownership separate from collaborative session documents within `studyPartnerConnections`.

**Querying Against Permissions (QAPs):**

The structure enables secure list operations:

1.  **Matching Algorithm:** The `GET /api/studyPartner/matches` API endpoint (as described in the user's prompt) is explicitly designed to be handled by a **Cloud Function**. This is crucial for QAPs. The Cloud Function will perform the complex queries and filtering on `StudyPartnerProfile` data *internally* (on the backend with elevated privileges), and then return only the *filtered and authorized* match candidates to the client. This prevents clients from performing broad `list` queries on sensitive `StudyPartnerProfile` data that cannot be filtered by security rules.

2.  **Active Partners & Personal Sessions:** Queries for `/studyPartnerConnections` (e.g., fetching active partners) and `/students/{studentId}/studySessions` (personal study history) are secure. Rules can enforce that `request.auth.uid` must match `studentId` or be one of the `participants` (`studentIdA` or `studentIdB`) for any read operation, satisfying the QAPs for these collections by leveraging direct field checks on the documents themselves.
